title: From Promising Capability to Pervasive Bias: Assessing Large Language Models for Emergency Department Triage

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual analysis by inserting altered sex attributes (Male, Female) into emergency department patient profiles to evaluate changes in LLM triage predictions.

Counterfactual analysis by substituting specific race categories (White, Black, Asian, Hispanic, American Indian, and Native Hawaiian/Asian Pacific Islander) into clinical notes to measure disparities in assigned triage acuity.
Systematically assessing the combined effects of sex and race by generating and evaluating all 12 counterfactual variations of demographic combinations in patient triage scenarios.
